MISS_FIRST_STAGE.description: Front-matter, tax notes, and accounting policy disclosures missing from first-stage index or BM25/dense query representations.

MISS_RANKING_BUDGET.description: Relevant chunk retrieved in candidate pool but truncated by reranker top-k.

MULTI_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE.description: Multi-statement / cross-period queries where 1 of 2 required evidence chunks was not ranked in top-k retrieval budget.

WRONG_PERIOD_RETRIEVAL.description: Retrieved chunk belonged to wrong fiscal year/quarter.
